title: Quick incident who-to-loop compact matrix
content:
Quick usage: one-page compact matrix for who to loop (P0/P1/P2). Keep terse handles. Meant as an ad-hoc spreadsheet to drop into incident channels and hand to incident leads.

Columns (CSV-friendly): Impact, Trigger (short), Primary(s) (handle), Channel (Slack/phone), Escalation (mins), Fallback (handle), Notes

Rows:
P0,Complete system outage (>=2 regions) ,oncall-sre (Samir Patel),#runtime-oncall / phone,15,eng-sre-lead (Nina Gomez),Open bridge, vendor contact, declare incident
P0,Hosted API 95th p99 latency >3s for >5m ,frontend-oncall (Oliver Park),#api-ops,15,dedicated-capacity-owner (Jessie Liu),Check autoscale + routing policy; consider fallback model
P1,Single-region repeat errors >10% over 10m ,api-backend-oncall (Jessie Liu),#api-ops,30,duty-engineer,Identify deployment/regression; enable canary fallback if needed
P1,Elevated error-rate affecting >1 customer SLA ,se-sre (Nina Gomez),#customer-ops,30,cs-ops-lead (Maya Chen),Notify CS, prepare customer-facing status
P2,Reduced throughput or intermittent retries,platform-rotations (Oliver Park),#platform-ops,60,service-owner,Track for 1hr before escalation
P2,Model quality regression (eval alert),ml-evals (Priya Kapoor),#ml-quality,60,prod-eng,Run golden prompts; consider model roll-back

Quick checks (ad-hoc rules):
- If alert text contains 'rate limit' => add billing@ and product-ops@ to thread.
- If external customer SLA mentioned => notify CS within 15m.
- For P0 always call phone list (tbd) after initial 15m Slack escalation.

Slack channels to ping (short): #runtime-oncall, #api-ops, #ml-quality, #incident-summaries, #cs-urgent

Open questions / TODOs (fragile working list):
- Should we add a 'Customer Impacted' boolean column? (asked by Nina)
- Finalize phone escalation list for P0 (owner: Samir) - target 2027-11-22
- Automate auto-posting of brief incident summary to #incident-summaries (owner: Oliver)
- Confirm whether Dedicated support rotation should be a separate primary handle or part of fallback (Jessie)

Action items (one-offs):
- [ ] (Samir) collate phone escalation numbers and permission matrix by 2027-11-22
- [ ] (Oliver) add a webhook that posts cause/impact/mitigation template after incident close
- [ ] (Nina) review matrix with SRE leads and confirm P0 phone policy by EOD 2027-11-19

Notes to self / rough style guide: keep rows short (less than 140 chars), use handles not full names, prefer Slack channel pings first except for declared P0. This is intentionally lightweight — intended to be copy/pasted into ad-hoc incident checklists and sprint retro notes.

Unresolved: where does this canonicalize? For now keep as shared drive sheet for iteration; once stable migrate to Confluence incident-runbook page.

Context: created during Q4 incident playbook scrub; cross-functional owners included to minimize ping noise during outages.
